title: Deep learning detects diabetic macular edema on fundus images
summary: Image-level sensitivity was 0.889, specificity 0.889 and AUC 0.954 on a participant-level validation split, with further validation on IDRiD and new data. External-validation numbers were not in the abstract reviewed.
ai_technology: Deep learning model trained on EyePACS fundus images (32,049 images from 15,892 patients)
organization: AEYE Health, Inc., New York, USA

evidence.tested: Participant-level validation split plus independent IDRiD and new data
evidence.unknown: External numbers not in abstract read; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning detects diabetic macular edema on fundus images

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
